steps: Build visual/v3 at d84923c with the local Vite exec shim.
Start V7 mock API on 8791 and static server on 8102 proxying /api to 8791.
Capture V6 baseline screenshots from the pre-V7 build at 4203046 for empty, messages and result states.
Set Edge headless viewports to 320x800, 768x1024 and 1440x900.
Open the empty state and verify 3 suggestion rows, no horizontal scroll and composer autofocus.
Open the message fixture and verify 5 rows, attachment thumb, fenced code block internal scroll and pending meta.
Open the result fixture and verify 3 result cards, 2-column grid at 768/1440, badges, disabled download and no page-level horizontal scroll.
Compare V7 empty and result screenshots byte-for-byte with the V6 baseline; compare messages allowing only the dynamic HH:mm glyph region.
Run V7 grep gates for dead components, legacy aliases, hex colors, outlines and font sizes.
Record screenshot paths, SHA-256, viewport metadata and environment notes in this file.
